purpose: Fail-closed source-rights policy for StatusPulse commercial incident records.
legal_note: This operational policy records a conservative source review; it is not legal advice or a substitute for written permission.

required_public_disclosures.analysis: StatusPulse calculations and normalized records are independently produced from the cited official sources.
required_public_disclosures.source_links: Each record must retain an exact official incident permalink.
required_public_disclosures.non_affiliation: StatusPulse is independent and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Atlassian or Google.
required_public_disclosures.historical_not_realtime: The dataset is historical research material, not a real-time monitoring or outage-alerting service.
required_public_disclosures.google_attribution: Source incident identifiers and factual service-health fields are attributed to Google Cloud through each official incident link.

atlassian.decision: Use the documented public Status API only, retaining a minimal factual normalization and an exact source link.
atlassian.attribution: Attribute every record to the exact Atlassian Status incident permalink; use Atlassian only as a plain-text source name and include the non-affiliation disclosure.

google-cloud.decision: Use the documented public JSON history interface and only fields documented as stable or factual identifiers; omit all descriptive text.
google-cloud.attribution: Attribute every record to the exact Google Cloud Service Health incident permalink and include the Google source attribution, non-affiliation, and historical-not-realtime disclosures.

github.decision: Do not access or store until written commercial-use permission is retained.
